item.title: Martin Luther King Jr’s historic speech draft heads to auction
item.description: A handwritten draft of Martin Luther King Jr's iconic 1963 speech will be auctioned at Christie's in January 2027. This manuscript, the only known handwritten final draft, includes significant edits made by King himself. The auction will benefit several charities, including the Xernona Clayton Foundation and The King Center. The draft will be publicly displayed starting January 15, 2027, before the auction. item.description: Scientists have identified two previously unknown howler monkey species in the Amazon rainforest through genetic research, 84 years after the last new species was described. Separately, camera traps captured a newly identified Mato Grosso red howler monkey crossing an artificial canopy bridge designed to reconnect fragmented forest habitats.
